annotations.title: Audit Shopify App Store Pricing, Churn & Unhappy Merchant Leads

description:
Audit Shopify App Store listings for USD pricing tiers, Built for Shopify badges, 5-star histograms, 14-language churn NLP, micro-PE scores, developer DNS/email contacts, and 1-2 star unhappy merchant leads.

Parameters: Set mode ("app_intelligence", "merchant_churn_leads" defaulting starFilter to "critical_1_2", or "partner_portfolio") and supply searchQueries, appHandlesOrUrls, categoryUrls, partnerUrlsOrSlugs, or upstreamItems (omitting all returns 0 items at $0). Bound runs with maxApps and maxReviewsPerApp, filter with onlyWithEmail, onlyBuiltForShopify, onlyVeteranChurn, switchIntentOnly, or minChurnRiskScore, and enable watchDiff with dedupStoreName ($0 unchanged). Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Persists KV snapshots when watchDiff is true and optionally posts to webhookUrl; bills $5/1K apps or $0.30/1K reviews ($0 on misses).

Use for Shopify App Store intel and unhappy merchant leads; do not use for storefront SKU deltas (monitor_shopify_competitor_deltas) or mobile apps (audit_app_store_churn_leads).

appHandlesOrUrls.description: Specific Shopify app handles or URLs (e.g. ["klaviyo-email-marketing", "judgeme", "https://apps.shopify.com/loox"]).

categoryUrls.description: Optional Shopify App Store category URLs or slugs (e.g. ["https://apps.shopify.com/categories/marketing-and-conversion-email-marketing"]).

crmPreset.description: Optional flat OWASP CSV-safe CRM export preset.

dedupStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist snapshots when watchDiff is enabled.

generateDashboardHtml.description: Save a self-contained interactive executive HTML dashboard to OUTPUT_DASHBOARD.html in the Key-Value Store.

includeDevWebsiteEnrich.description: Enrich developer support email, official website URL, and DNS MX/SPF/DMARC deliverability.

maxApps.description: Maximum Shopify apps to analyze per run (1-500).

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Maximum merchant review leads extracted per app in merchant_churn_leads mode (10-2,000).

minChurnRiskScore.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps with churnRiskScore >= threshold ($0 below).

mode.description: Execution mode: "app_intelligence" ($5/1K apps), "merchant_churn_leads" ($0.30/1K reviews), or "partner_portfolio" ($5/1K apps).

onlyBuiltForShopify.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps carrying the Built for Shopify badge ($0 otherwise).

onlyVeteranChurn.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps or merchant leads showing veteran-store churn (>=180 days usage, $0 otherwise).

onlyWithEmail.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps where a developer email is verified ($0 otherwise).

partnerUrlsOrSlugs.description: Optional Shopify developer partner slugs or URLs for partner_portfolio mode (e.g. ["klaviyo"]).

sampleReviewsPerApp.description: Recent reviews sampled per app in app_intelligence mode to compute churn divergence and pain buckets (10-200).

searchQueries.description: Shopify App Store search keywords (e.g. ["product reviews", "email marketing", "subscriptions"]).

starFilter.description: Review star filter (defaults to "critical_1_2" in merchant_churn_leads mode and "all" in app_intelligence mode).

switchIntentOnly.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps or merchant leads mentioning switching to a named competitor ($0 otherwise).

upstreamItems.description: Optional upstream pipeline items containing appHandle, appUrl, partnerSlug, or query fields.

watchDiff.description: Compare against prior KV snapshots to flag pricing, Built for Shopify, rating, and new critical review changes ($0 when unchanged).

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL to receive high-churn or watchDiff alerts.

name: audit_shopify_app_churn_leads

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Shopify App Store intelligence dossiers or unhappy merchant review leads.

isBuiltForShopify.description: Whether the app currently holds the Built for Shopify badge.

minPaidPriceUsd.description: Lowest paid monthly plan price normalized to USD.

overallRating.description: Lifetime Shopify App Store star rating.

silentChurnDivergence.description: Recent minus lifetime rating delta (negative indicates silent churn).

switcherPriorityScore.description: 0-100 unhappy merchant switching score (in merchant_churn_leads mode).
